subject.title: fix: restrict releases to reviewed dispatches

question: Should Crabbox replace tag-push and ref-selectable manual production releases with default-branch repository_dispatch for this security fix?
rationale: The PR changes the credentialed production release boundary and removes existing operator entrypoints, which is a maintainer security/operations choice rather than a purely mechanical code review question.

options.title: Approve dispatch-only releases after proof
options.body: Use repository_dispatch as the only production release entrypoint, require the new tag ancestry guard, and merge after redacted proof or a disposable-repo transcript confirms the path.

options.title: Keep a guarded legacy entrypoint
options.body: Revise the workflow to retain tag-push or workflow_dispatch only if the same pre-secret default-branch ancestry guard protects that entrypoint.

options.title: Pause for release-policy discussion
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide whether the operator workflow change is acceptable for the next release.

recommendation.title: Approve dispatch-only releases after proof
recommendation.body: Use repository_dispatch as the only production release entrypoint, require the new tag ancestry guard, and merge after redacted proof or a disposable-repo transcript confirms the path.
